evidence: The numbers of cycles used to deposit different films are given in Table I. The thicknesses of the resulting films determined by XRR are also shown in this table. The growth per cycle values for pure ZrO2 and Gd2O3 were 0.058 and 0.036 nm/cycle, respectively, whereas in nanolaminates, these values were 0.05 and 0.02 nm/cycle, indicating an inhibited growth of the constituent materials upon each other, especially Gd2O3 on ZrO2.
